MitoMapa · Tenerife
Dácil and the Return
of Magec
TENERIFE Dácil and the Return of Magec
Contents
3

stories.label: Tenerife: first page
stories.text:
When the Guanches lived among
ravines and valleys, Dácil looked after
goats near Echeyde. Each dawn she
waited for the first ray of Magec, the
Sun, before setting out.
TENERIFE Dácil and the Return of Magec
Contents
4

stories.label: Tenerife: the story continues
stories.text:
But one morning, the light did not
come. A black cloud covered the
mountain, and the ground shook
beneath their feet. The elders
remembered the story of Guayota, the
being who lived inside the volcano.
According to tradition, he had captured
Magec and was keeping him hidden in
the darkness.
TENERIFE Dácil and the Return of Magec
Contents
